text.p: Factfile on Stefan Edberg, who played his last individual tournament singles match when he lost to fellow Swede Niklas Kulti at the Stockholm Open on Tuesday:
Born: January 19, 1966, at Vastervik, Sweden, and took up tennis aged 7.
Turned professional: 1983, when he was world number one junior and first player to win junior grand slam of French, Wimbledon, US and Australian titles.
- Also won men's doubles, with Anders Jarryd, at 1987 Australian and U.S. Opens.
Davis Cup: Helped Sweden to lift trophy for first time in 1984. Led them to victory in 1994 by winning six of his eight singles matches.
Career record: Has played 1,075 matches, winning 806. World number one at end of 1990 and 1991. In world top 10 for 10 consecutive years, 1985-94.
